# Harrison Barrow, Attorney at Law, P.C.

> Cape Cod trial attorney based in Hyannis, Massachusetts, and Of Counsel at Princi Mills Law PC. Harrison Barrow represents clients in Criminal Defense (OUI/DUI, domestic violence, drug offenses, assault, sex crimes, firearm charges, theft, and white collar crimes) and Civil Litigation (construction disputes, mechanic's liens, payment disputes, breach of contract, partnership conflicts, and M.G.L. c. 93A). Third-generation attorney with proven trial experience. Free consultation: (508) 945-1400.

## Key facts
- Attorney: Harrison Barrow, a third-generation trial lawyer and second-generation MA criminal defense lawyer. He is Of Counsel at Princi Mills Law PC, holds a perfect Avvo 10.0 Superb rating, and is recognized among the Top 100 Trial Lawyers and Top 40 Under 40 (The National Trial Lawyers).
- Focus Areas: Criminal Defense, Civil Litigation & Business Disputes.
- Phone: (508) 945-1400
- Office: 300 Barnstable Road, Hyannis, MA 02601 (Of Counsel at Princi Mills Law PC).
- Service area: Cape Cod, Barnstable County, and all 14 Massachusetts counties.

## Practice areas
- [OUI / DUI Defense](https://harrisonbarrow.com/criminal-defense/oui-dui/): Operating under the influence, breath-test refusals, and license hearings.
- [Drug Crimes](https://harrisonbarrow.com/criminal-defense/drug-crimes/): Possession, distribution, trafficking, and school-zone charges.
- [Assault & Battery](https://harrisonbarrow.com/criminal-defense/assault-battery/): Simple assault, A&B, and assault with a dangerous weapon.
- [Domestic Violence](https://harrisonbarrow.com/criminal-defense/domestic-violence/): A&B on a household member and 209A restraining orders.
- [Sex Crimes](https://harrisonbarrow.com/criminal-defense/sex-crimes/): Indecent assault & battery, internet offenses, and SORB hearings.
- [Gun & Firearm Crimes](https://harrisonbarrow.com/criminal-defense/gun-firearm-crimes/): Unlawful possession, carrying, and licensing offenses.
- [Theft & Larceny](https://harrisonbarrow.com/criminal-defense/theft-larceny/): Shoplifting, larceny, receiving stolen property, and fraud.
- [White Collar Crimes](https://harrisonbarrow.com/criminal-defense/white-collar-crimes/): Fraud, embezzlement, forgery, and financial crimes.
- [Civil Litigation](https://harrisonbarrow.com/civil-litigation/): Commercial contract breaches, business litigation, mechanic's liens / construction disputes, M.G.L. c. 93A consumer protection claims (both prosecution and defense), and personal injury.
